descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.5; TFA-92596 AC 2 · “the physician taps Generate and can move to the next patient”. Mixed: stated part — billing stored for the note when the physician returns without opening Post-Round; our part — switching to another patient's Post-Round while billing runs, cards never mixing (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S12 Switching or leaving right after Generate: each billing card belongs to its own patient's note, and (with server-side Generate) the billing is there when the physician comes back without having opened Post-Round

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The final generated note is the source of truth; the model only suggests the level within the family the template fixed. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U14 Run in both Hospital and Nursing Home and pass in both; Nursing Home has a working billing block with the SNF families. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-21 step 6; TFA-92599 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-92599 in progress
  • U17 Generate runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to the next patient; the note and its billing suggestion (which runs at Generate) are there when they come back, whether or not th … (UAT 3.5; UAT TC-18; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U5 Billing runs once at Generate and does not re-run when the note is edited (step 5). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given switch-h2n / switch-n2h: both fixtures seeded with distinct notes (the S10 notes: Hospital about ceftriaxone / azithromycin / cough, resident about walker / senna / acetaminophen), no billing stored on the patient that will be switched to. leave-h / leave-n: fixtures with nothing generated

When switch-h2n: Generate on the Hospital patient, open Post-Round ('Analyzing note…'), switch to the resident's Post-Round within 2 s, wait, then go back to the Hospital Post-Round. switch-n2h: the same from the resident to the Hospital patient. leave-h / leave-n: Generate and leave at once without opening Post-Round; …

Then Each card shows its own family and quotes only its own note, never the other patient's words; each row's billingForNoteAt equals its own noteGeneratedAt. After the 60 s the stored row already holds a billing suggestion for that note, and opening Post-Round shows it with no new billing call

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): switch legs: every card mustContainAny its own family, mustNotContain the other family and the no-result texts, billingCard quotesInNote against its own note on the same snapshot, and mustNotContain the other note's marker words (Hospital page: walker, senna, acetaminophen; resident page: ceftriaxone, azithromycin, cough); …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
